title: A Twin Manifest survives a round-trip unchanged
rationale: The manifest is the artifact that crosses the language boundary. If an implementation cannot read back what it wrote, byte-for-byte in value if not in whitespace, nothing else in the ecosystem composes.

checks.closed_form: Serialising a manifest with a NaN parameter must raise. RFC 8259 has no NaN or Infinity; the adapter reports either the error it raised or the bytes it wrote, and the runner judges.
